about: Claims with a known verdict as of October 2026, for scripts/eval_verdicts.py. 'also_ok' lists verdicts that are defensible but not the one Sayproof should give (scored as lenient only).

claims.claim: The Eiffel Tower grows by about 15 centimetres in summer.
claims.note: toureiffel.paris says the tower grows a few millimetres; 15 cm is the curve the top traces in the sun. Popular sources say 15 cm.

talks.text: Hi everyone, thanks for coming, I'm really excited to be here. Since our launch in spring, our users tripled. And here is a fun fact: the Great Wall of China is visible from space. I think that's amazing. Next year we will reach a million users.

Good morning. My presentation is about our solar system. Pluto is our ninth planet. Venus is the hottest planet, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun. Personally, Saturn is my favourite. Light from the Sun needs about eight minutes to reach the Earth.
Hallo zusammen. Ich finde Berlin die schönste Stadt der Welt. Die Berliner Mauer fiel 1991. Der Fernsehturm ist 368 Meter hoch. Unser Verein hat heute 120 Mitglieder. Ich hoffe, ihr habt Spaß.

So, quick update on the product. Our churn dropped by half after the redesign, according to our own dashboard. Studies show that people only use ten percent of their brains, so we kept the screens simple. I believe this is the best onboarding on the market. We'll ship the new version in March.
